o1: Enables mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase binding activity and protein kinase activity. Predicted to enable MAP kinase scaffold activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-positive bacterium; Ras protein signal transduction, including positive regulation; and positive regulation of vulval development. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Predicted to interact with mek-2. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including KSR1 (kinase suppressor of ras 1).
